metadata.title: The Minimal Background Period for Infinitely Many Spectral Gaps in Anderson-Bernoulli Models
metadata.abstract: We prove that three is the smallest background period for which a one-dimensional discrete Anderson-Bernoulli operator can have infinitely many gaps in its almost-sure spectrum. For an explicit period-three background and coupling, we construct infinitely many bounded gaps accumulating from the right at a spectral energy, for every nondegenerate Bernoulli law. This property persists on an open set of background and coupling parameters. The proof combines a transverse heteroclinic connection and invariant multicones with spectral points from periodic realizations. A strict geometric window permits integer scale matching, and the required parameter inequalities are verified by exact rational arithmetic.

analysis.progressType: Anderson–Bernoulli 无限谱隙的最小背景周期
analysis.workSummary: 证明一维离散 Anderson–Bernoulli 算子若可在几乎必然谱中有无穷多个谱隙，最小背景周期是三。对显式周期三背景和耦合，任意非退化 Bernoulli 概率律均有无穷多个有界谱隙从右侧向一个谱能量聚集。该性质在背景与耦合参数的开集上保持。
analysis.breakthrough: 用严格几何窗口保证整数尺度匹配，从而同时得到构造、阈值和参数稳健性。
analysis.limitations: 结论针对一维离散模型、背景周期及非退化二点 Bernoulli 律。谱隙从一侧积聚的陈述属于所构造参数。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。对本版本共37页的全文和候选元数据做标准及补充搜索，未观察到作者披露自身使用 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 动力系统的双曲几何给出随机算子谱隙的精确周期阈值。
